# Copilot instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` first. Ask every question with options (`Ask (choice)` / `Ask (multi)` in the skills, approvals included) as a numbered list, recommended option first, "Back" (to the previous question or step) as the last number except on the first question. This repo has a live Storybook of the default Web reference design system (folder in `references.json`, today `Reference_Library/Trianglz/Web/storybook/`): at the start of a session, mention it in one line (information only); ask about the project first and about Storybook only at intake 0.7, for a project with pending Storybook work, or when the user asks Run it with `npm install` then `npm run storybook` in that folder (Node.js 18+, ask before installing); it serves http://localhost:6006 and a Storybook MCP at http://localhost:6006/mcp.
